actions.rationale: Sidecar has zero open positions. Deploy $50m of the $100m gross cap into the primary hawkish expression: long implied-rate SOFR_2027-09 at the packet mid of 4.755%. Size is half the book because the 25bp hike was already >90% priced, 2Y has already backed up 57bp in 1m, and SR3 positioning is unknown; still large enough that expected terminal repricing can clear the 3.85% SOFR funding vig that is charged whether flat or deployed.

events.invalidation: SR3U7 retraces the 17-Sep SOFR jump and Dec-26 SR3 prices less than one hike versus 3.85% overnight.
events.rationale: FACT: Fed hiked 25bp to 3.75-4.00%; SOFR 3.85%; SR3U7 implies 4.755% then the strip eases; August CPI kept a tightening bias; US labor gauge 75 with payrolls +162k and U-rate 4.1%; BoJ hiked, BoE 6-3 with three hike votes. INFERENCE: inflation persistence and a still-restrictive reaction function imply a higher 2027 terminal than 4.75% and no 2028 cut residual. The 25bp meeting was >90% priced; the mispricing is the path. Long implied-rate SOFR_2027-09 owns that. UNKNOWN: SR3 positioning; whether gauge 72 overstates July core PCE; whether an energy-tail fade (Saudi STS) caps further hikes.
